data_fields.name: xp_reward_difficulty_index
data_fields.donor_constant: per-quest column RewardXPDifficulty, index into quest XP table (table not read)

best_idea: One event loop credits per-objective counters in one per-player ledger and completes the quest on the same event, with the XP level-gap curve held as engine data.
decision_why: Take the shape (per-objective counters in one ledger, completion check on each event, level-gap XP curve as engine data) and fix the speak-to defect (continue lets one talk fill two objectives); reject the copied flag set and per-NPC speak credit, since the one-engine ruling needs one server interaction path.
acceptance: A server test asserts a 4-kill objective completes on its 4th kill with no counts past the required value, a talk that targets two objectives of one quest increments exactly one, and a full-bag reward appears in the mailbox list.
